name: sme-full-transpose-padded-stride
hypothesis: Start from existing-sme, the strongest measured source. Add 32 floats of unused padding between transposed A rows. At n=512, this changes the row stride from 2048 to 2176 bytes. The hypothesis is that this reduces cache conflicts and repeated cache-line reads during multiplication. Padding is never initialized or consumed. The panel-packing trials did not establish an improvement, so this candidate retains the full transpose and baseline arithmetic. This candidate is unmeasured; the supplied results do not establish the 1780 GFLOP/s target.
